title: The Mystery School: the graded canon as a Library pane
acceptance: /school and /library/school open a Library pane that shows the Gate, the seven houses with their three degrees, and the five reading paths; every text is reachable from the Lectern's plain lists without the Wheel.

Every one of the 66 records shows one of three honest states resolved from the content manifest: readable, carried but not served (with the archive's reason), or not yet carried (with the free edition named).

A readable text opens Reader setup with the house's colour theme and a school origin; leaving the reading returns to the school focused on that house; a finished reading marks the text in a local record that the reader's data export and erase include.
Rendered at 1440, 1280x720 and 390x844 with no overflow, no colliding labels, and the Lectern never clipped; reduced motion stops the wheel's turn.
The browser gate includes a school spec; the fast unit list and the route, pane and exit tests are updated; the first-load budget is unchanged.

evidence.note: Design: the Wheel and the Lectern, the record, the three states, routing, progress, the three owner questions.
The pane, data, launch, return, completion, browser gate spec and design; 25 commits.

activity.summary: Claimed from the owner's plan of 2026-10-13; spec written; data modules under way.

summary: The owner's plan of 2026-10-13 gives RISE a free, graded curriculum of 66 public domain texts in seven planetary houses with three degrees each, a Gate text and five cross-house reading paths. This task builds it as a Library pane: a wheel that maps houses, degrees and paths, a lectern that reads what the wheel points at, honest per-text states resolved from the content manifest (four texts are readable today), a launch into Reader setup under the house's colour, and a local record of what was read. Admitting more editions is the owner's call (spec §9) and a separate lane.
